title: Security
description: Registration, sessions, password policy and account ownership.

access.title: Access & sessions
access.description: Who can create an account and how long an idle session stays signed in.
access.selfRegistrationOn: Employees can register from the sign-in page. Every registration waits for HR approval.
access.selfRegistrationOff: The registration page is closed. HR invites users from Users or an employee's profile.
access.sessionTimeoutHint: Signed-in users are signed out after this period without activity.
access.readOnly: Changing these settings requires the Settings › Edit permission.

activity.title: Recent sign-in activity
activity.description: The latest 20 sign-ins and sign-outs across the portal.
activity.noPermission: Viewing sign-in activity requires the Audit › View permission.

owners.title: Super Admin owners
owners.description: {count, plural, =0 {No active owners} one {# active owner} other {# active owners}}
owners.noPermission: Viewing owners requires the Users › View permission.
owners.singleOwner: Only one active Super Admin. Add a second owner so the organization never loses administrative access.
owners.hint: Super Admins control every setting. The last active Super Admin can never be removed or disabled.

password.title: Password policy
password.minLength: At least {count, plural, one {{count} character} other {{count} characters}}
password.managed: Enforced by the authentication service for every new password. To change it, update the password requirements in the Supabase Auth settings (Authentication › Providers › Email).

email.title: Email delivery
email.configuredHint: Invitations, password resets and notifications are sent from this address. Delivery is recorded in the email log.
email.notConfiguredHint: Emails aren’t sent until RESEND_API_KEY or SMTP settings and EMAIL_FROM are configured on the server. Attempts are recorded as skipped.

timeout.title: Are you still there?
timeout.description: For your security you’ll be signed out in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} because of inactivity.
